clusters.headline: Keppel CEO Loh Chin Hua Defends Proposed StarHub and M1 Merger
aiSummaryBullets: Keppel chief executive Loh Chin Hua identified StarHub as the most viable partner for a merger with M1.
The proposed merger is expected to reach completion by mid-2027, with no changes planned for mobile plan pricing until that time.

clusters.headline: DPM Gan Kim Yong Calls For ASEAN Integration Amid Economic Shifts
aiSummaryBullets: Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong advised against erecting barriers between ASEAN members in response to rising economic nationalism.
Singapore's trade minister highlighted that maintaining open integration and broadening partnerships remains essential for regional prosperity.

clusters.headline: Jensen Huang Returns As Nvidia CEO Following Pressure From Trump
aiSummaryBullets: Jensen Huang has officially resumed his leadership position as the chief executive officer of Nvidia.
The return follows a period of corporate transition and reported pressure from investors and President Donald Trump.

clusters.headline: Singapore Food Agency Ends Suspension Of Caterer Deli Hub Catering
aiSummaryBullets: The Singapore Food Agency has officially lifted its suspension of catering firm Deli Hub.
The decision follows the company's compliance with mandated sanitization and cleaning protocols.

clusters.headline: Multiple Singapore Organizations Report Recent Customer Data Breaches
aiSummaryBullets: Fullerton Health reported a data breach impacting approximately 140,000 migrant workers.
Clothing retailer Our Second Nature experienced an incident exposing customer contact details and addresses.

clusters.headline: K Shanmugam Emphasizes Institutional Boundaries In Government
aiSummaryBullets: K Shanmugam highlighted the importance of mutual respect between the government, parliament, and the judiciary.
The minister noted that the government should respect court rulings even when they diverge from policy goals.

clusters.headline: Singapore Launches One Family Service Model For Integrated Support
aiSummaryBullets: The new One Family Service model will integrate nine distinct government-funded social support programs.
Participating families will be assigned a primary caseworker to manage their specific, coordinated case plan.

clusters.headline: Doctor Anywhere And M1 Report Data Security Breaches In Singapore
aiSummaryBullets: Telemedicine platform Doctor Anywhere confirmed a recent data breach on its network.
Telecommunications provider M1 also disclosed a separate unauthorized access to its systems.

clusters.headline: Derek Khor Boon Chun Jailed Over Etomidate Kpod Trafficking Case
aiSummaryBullets: Derek Khor Boon Chun was sentenced to more than three years in prison.
The conviction follows his role in trafficking 43 Kpods containing etomidate.

clusters.headline: Ferrari Principal Voices Frustration Following Leclerc-Hamilton Clash
aiSummaryBullets: Ferrari management has publicly criticized the recent collision involving drivers Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton.
The incident marks the latest in a series of racing disputes between the two prominent competitors.

clusters.headline: Singapore Changi Airport Increases Hiring Of Air Traffic Personnel
aiSummaryBullets: Changi Airport is increasing its recruitment efforts for air traffic control professionals.
The initiative is focused on ensuring sufficient staffing levels ahead of the Terminal 5 launch.

clusters.headline: Singapore respects ICJ ruling in genocide case against Myanmar: MFA
aiSummaryBullets: The Straits Times reports: Singapore respects ICJ ruling in genocide case against Myanmar: MFA
CNA reports: Singapore studying implications after ICJ finds Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya

clusters.headline: Singapore Land Authority Awards Balestier Market Revamp Contract
aiSummaryBullets: The Singapore Land Authority awarded the tenure of the historic Balestier Market to Hua Hng Trading Co Pte Ltd.
Plans for the property at 411 Balestier Road include an updated wet market alongside new dining and retail businesses.

clusters.headline: Reports Suggest Potential Leadership Changes At Nvidia Corporation
aiSummaryBullets: Media coverage suggests Nvidia may be preparing to remove CEO Jensen Huang.
The reports follow allegations regarding two extramarital affairs involving the executive.

clusters.headline: GTA VI Global Sales Record And Singapore Influencer Viral Moment
aiSummaryBullets: Grand Theft Auto VI generated 3.79 billion dollars in revenue within its initial 24 hours of availability.
A Singapore-based content creator garnered international attention following a viral video featuring a contract made with his spouse.

aiSummaryBullets: CNA reports: Australia, Solomon Islands sign sweeping pact stymieing China
The Straits Times reports: Singapore, Australia expand essential supplies pact, sign landmark carbon storage agreement

CNA reports: Ex-auxiliary police officer jailed after raising anti-terrorism barrier, causing bus crash at Changi Airport

aiSummaryBullets: The Straits Times reports: Simulated bomb-strapped drone used in anti-terror exercise at Esplanade

clusters.headline: Singapore Civil Servants Awarded Year-End Bonus Of 1.55 Months
aiSummaryBullets: Civil servants will receive a year-end bonus amounting to 1.55 months of their salary.
Junior officers in specific grades are eligible for supplementary one-time payments.
